sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ring_cells():
    a = current_frame.ascii
    lines = a.split('\n')
    cells = []
    for r in range(14,30):
        for c in range(32,50):
            if lines[r][c]=='p':
                cells.append((r,c))
    return cells

def centers():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('W','p','G') and n['pixels'] >= 10:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']] = ((min(rows)+max(rows))//2, (min(cols)+max(cols))//2)
    return out

print("A: click bottom border (63,27)")
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':63,'col':27}])
print("  ring:", sorted(ring_cells()), "centers:", centers(), "no_impact:", r.get('no_impact'))
print("B: click play area (40,50)")
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':40,'col':50}])
print("  ring:", sorted(ring_cells()), "centers:", centers(), "no_impact:", r.get('no_impact'))
print("C: click top-right border (2,55) with white OUT of ring")
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':2,'col':55}])
print("  ring:", sorted(ring_cells()), "centers:", centers(), "no_impact:", r.get('no_impact'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def ring_cells():
    a = current_frame.ascii
    lines = a.split('\n')
    cells = []
    for r in range(14,30):
        for c in range(32,50):
            if lines[r][c]=='p':
                cells.append((r,c))
    return cells

def centers():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('W','p','G') and n['pixels'] >= 10:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']] = ((min(rows)+max(rows))//2, (min(cols)+max(cols))//2)
    return out
